purpose.zh: 活动髋部，练习背部中立
purpose.en: Mobilize the hips while keeping a neutral back.

text.zh: 背部保持中立，臀部向脚跟后坐
text.en: Keep your back neutral and rock your hips back toward your heels
Keep your hands planted and your arms straight.

text.zh: 背开始变圆前停住，再向前回
text.en: Stop before your back starts to round, then rock forward.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back as you rock back.

cautions.zh: 髋或膝不适时减小幅度
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hips or knees feel uncomfortable.

cautions.zh: 先做手腕热身；手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first, and stop if they feel sharp pain or numbness.
